note: Mechanism-step vocabulary. BYPASS steps MUST carry a `bypasses` field naming the guard family they defeat (e.g. bypasses: guard.waf), drawn from vocab/slot_families.json.

primitives.NORMALIZE: The system parses/normalizes the input (URL, encoding, format).
primitives.PARSE: Input is interpreted by a parser (SQL, template, binary, protocol).
primitives.CONCAT: Input is spliced into a larger string/command/structure.
primitives.LOOKUP: Input selects a lookup target (column, key, path).
primitives.DESERIALIZE: Input names types that the runtime instantiates.
primitives.CALLBACK: Attacker-influenced data causes a callback/method dispatch.
primitives.READ: Data is read from a location the attacker influenced.
primitives.WRITE: Data is written to a location the attacker influenced.
primitives.CONNECT: A network connection is made to an attacker-influenced target.
primitives.COMPARE: A comparison/decision happens on attacker-influenced state.
primitives.SANITIZE: The system attempts to neutralize the input.
primitives.BYPASS: A guard/defense is defeated — REQUIRES a `bypasses` field naming the guard family.
